Beacon Insurance is a successful enterprise account, while Meridian Retail Group is a high-risk account requiring intervention to avoid churn.

Beacon Insurance, an Enterprise Plan customer, had a highly successful Q2 2026 [NL-025-S01]. Adoption exceeded targets for KnowledgeHub (96.0%), TutorChat (92.2%), and CourseBuilder (80.4%), though InsightDash underperformed at 35.5% [NL-025-S03]. Business outcomes included reduced new-claims-adjuster onboarding time from 6.2 to 4.0 weeks, a 22% decline in support escalations, and 94% verified-query citation trust [NL-025-S04]. Beacon is positioned for expansion, with interest in joining the WorkflowCoach beta, adding 600 seats to reach 4,100 learners, and raising ACV from $112,000 to $136,000 [NL-025-S06][NL-025-S02][NL-025-S06].

Meridian Retail Group is classified as High Risk, with renewal probability estimated at less than 40% without intervention [NL-026-S02]. Key risk drivers are support ticket delays exceeding SLAs, unresolved permission-mapping friction from manual folder-based controls, and a critical Microsoft Teams integration gap where the feature is still in design phase after Meridian's renewal date [NL-026-S02]. The recommended plan is a pro-bono upgrade to the Enterprise Plan through October 15, 2026, including a dedicated CSM, audit logs, extended data retention, SCIM/AD provisioning, and a discounted renewal path [NL-026-S05]. This risk profile is specific to Meridian's decentralized retail structure and should not be generalized to the broader Growth Plan segment [NL-026-S02].
